terra.problem: Peter does not say the trial is not a sign that something went wrong. That adds an assurance the verse does not give.
The claim that the trial has not caught God off guard goes beyond what the passage says and has no supporting reference.
Papa says he hid in the drawer, but his backstory says he was put there.
The price-sticker comparison has no clear connection to carrying the name Christian, so the joke does not make sense.
Peter says not to be ashamed and to glorify God. The explanation adds that he wants them to feel proud.
Saying the question is meant to make the baker stop and think assigns Peter a purpose the text does not state.
Saying the instruction is to entrust, not to defend, makes defense sound prohibited. Peter does not address it here.
